activeQuestion.prompt: What should riders do to avoid missing an evening train?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 乘客怎麼安排才不易錯過晚間的火車？

options.text: Take an earlier shuttle to allow more time for the connection.
options.zh: 搭較早的接駁車，為轉乘多留一些時間。
options.whyZh: 接駁車照時出發不代表準時到站；晚間車程可能多十分鐘，而火車時刻不變，因此應先留足轉乘時間。

options.text: Keep the usual shuttle because it leaves on schedule.
options.zh: 照常搭原班次，因為接駁車依時刻發車。
options.whyZh: 公告保證的是發車依時刻，不是到站時間不變。

options.text: Take a later shuttle because the train will also run later.
options.zh: 搭較晚的接駁車，因為火車也會晚開。
options.whyZh: 公告明說火車時刻沒有改變。

options.text: Wait until after the fair because evening shuttles are cancelled.
options.zh: 等市集結束再離開，因為晚間接駁車取消了。
options.whyZh: 公告說晚間車仍照表發車，沒有取消。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 接駁車照時出發不代表準時到站；晚間車程可能多十分鐘，而火車時刻不變，因此應先留足轉乘時間。
activeQuestion.evidence: Evening departures stay on schedule, but rides may take ten minutes longer. Train times haven’t changed.

vocabulary.note: 指接駁車到站後轉搭下一段交通工具。

originalQuestion.prompt: What should evening rush-hour passengers allow for?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 晚間尖峰時段乘客應預留什麼？

options.text: A new fare for wheelchair users.
options.whyZh: 公告只說臨時站有輪椅通行設施，未更改票價。

options.text: The cancellation of the last bus.
options.whyZh: 首班與末班時間維持不變，沒有取消末班。
公告說尖峰車程最多可能增加十分鐘；雖首末班不變，乘客仍應多留行車時間。

options.text: A twenty-minute walk from the library.
options.zh: 從圖書館步行二十分鐘。
options.whyZh: 步行距離約五分鐘；最多十分鐘是車程增加量。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 公告說尖峰車程最多可能增加十分鐘；雖首末班不變，乘客仍應多留行車時間。
originalQuestion.evidence: journeys may take up to ten minutes longer during the evening rush hour.

vocabulary.note: 通勤需求集中、路況較壅塞的時段。

group.title: A temporary river shuttle route
group.passage: Friday’s river shuttle skips Market Street for the fair. The sports centre is closer, but its path has steps. Riverside Gate has a level path. Folded bikes can go on any shuttle. Other bikes need a trailer. The first shuttle has none; the next does. Evening departures stay on schedule, but rides may take ten minutes longer. Train times haven’t changed.
group.passageZh: 星期五市集期間，河岸接駁車不停靠市場街。運動中心較近，但沿路有階梯；河岸入口的路是平的。折疊後的自行車可搭任何一班；其他自行車需要拖車。首班車沒掛拖車，下一班有。傍晚仍照表發車，但車程可能多十分鐘。火車時刻維持不變。
